findings: The original product runner still validates the sealed complete plan, requires a matching manifest, invokes the authoritative fenced consume, rejects replay, then releases rows. The sole new production permit literal is at the original release position after successful Recorded consumption.

The non-Clone permit has private plan and receipt fields. The file provider compares the entire sealed product plan and actual receipt fields, marks its one release attempt before fallible row I/O, and refuses the public receipt-only API. Existing provider implementations keep their synchronous legacy receipt default.

The held regular file is OS-locked, length bounded, and bound to the full actual canonical material digest before and during release. The codec carries actual training rows, targets, both OPE observation sets, assignments and snapshot/future-window IDs with bounded counts, typed values and exact trailing-byte rejection. The original runner retains its complete statistical/comparability validation.

The original execution-storage contract accepts immutable bounded opaque completion bytes. Its concrete file implementation retains held lock, append+fsync, independently witnessed recovery minimum, exact binding conflicts, immutable completed payloads and sticky live-metadata/write uncertainty. Reusing it under a separate evidence-domain namespace preserves those source semantics.

Root identified that the first sink draft keyed by evaluation_id could publish a different decision for the same execution under a new ID. The final reviewed source keys only by actual execution_digest inside the independent owner namespace; the entire decision including evaluation_id stays in the immutable payload. The added real-file regression requires changed ID to refuse without journal/anchor changes.

The sink serializes the exact runner execution and full public decision, trust and authentication digests, checks DENY_ALL, and returns a publication digest only after durable claim/complete and exact readback. Pending or uncertain completion stays closed; no sealed qualification receipt is reconstructed.

The original qualify_and_persist still performs its signed V2/V3 admission and scope/role checks before sink.persist and seals a DENY_ALL receipt only after a nonzero durable publication result. It does not select or activate a candidate.

Eight newly declared component tests exercise the original runner and actual file/CAS/sink composition, copied-receipt refusal, consume replay, full-plan mismatch, corrupt/malformed material, immutable publication, durable pending, lock/recovery rollback/torn history and sticky uncertainty. Their rows/keys are explicit fixtures and tests were read, not executed.
host_obligations: Actual concrete LockedFileFinalHoldoutCasStoreV1 in the production coordinator, rather than an unauthenticated arbitrary host CAS implementation.
Authorized independently held files, exclusive open-description custody and required file/path permissions; namespace separation, directory durability and externally retained recovery anchors.
Genuine independently collected holdout inputs, authenticated Generator/Evaluator/Observer roles and complete signed cost evidence and budgets.
Actual production constructor callers in the future daemon adapter, original caller metadata updates and complete fixed-source qualification.
